messages:
emma: Quick thread to lock down the migration plan for evidence namespaces. We need a low-risk path to rename the event stream fields for the new audit schema without breaking existing Dedicated customers.

ravi: Plan idea: support dual-read for 2 sprints where writer emits both legacy and new fields (legacy_tenant_id, tenant_hash_v2). Readers prefer new by env flag. Then run a deprecation cycle.

maya: Security concern: avoid duplicating plaintext tenant IDs in either field. Both must be pseudonymized; legacy field can be mapped at ingest to maintain parity.

drew: Ops note: dual-write increases index size. We'll enable a feature-flagged rollout and monitor storage. Purge worker must interpret both fields for legal-hold lookups.

lisa: Legal asks that migration steps are documented with dates and that exports include a migration_manifest describing which schema version each bundle uses. Also require backward-compatible proofs for audits covering the migration window.

emma: Proposed migration steps: 1) spec v2 merged, 2) writer dual-emits for 2 sprints behind a feature flag, 3) readers switch to new fields in staging, 4) run export sanity and auditor replay tests, 5) flip in production, 6) start deprecation log and remove legacy after 90 days.

ravi: I'll add a fallback lookup that if export bundle sees legacy fields, it populates the `migration_manifest`. Also will add a small shim in exporter to include both `schema_tag` and `migration_window` in bundle headers.

maya: Security will require an automated smoke test that validates tamper-chain continuity across the migration (previous_hash -> new_hash).

drew: Ops will track `migration_active` metric, extra_storage_bytes, and export_fail_rate. Add an alert if export_fail_rate > 0.5% during rollout.

lisa: Legal: require a short-run policy that during migration we keep raw receipts for an extra 30 days so audits overlapping the window can request continuity. We'll log that as `migration_retention_boost` in onboarding records.

emma: launch checklist draft:@ravi - dual-write PR + feature flag, @drew - metrics + purge compatibility, @maya - tamper-chain smoke tests, @lisa - migration_retention_boost policy text. I'll schedule a 15-min sync before the sprint cut.

compliance-bot: Note: RFC #907 "evidence-namespace-migration" opened by emma. CI: schema lint OK, dual-write PR pending.
